new_value: Implemented in b6be91c. did:key proves by having the local ssh-agent -- which holds ed25519 keys and already speaks a signing protocol this crate speaks -- sign the challenge with the key the identifier encodes. The decoder is fixed-width over 34 bytes and refuses any other multicodec, so an X25519 agreement key cannot answer a signing challenge. ChallengeSignature::verify_did_key_ed25519 binds the DID to the candidate path, the point to the DID and the signature to the challenge. did:web and did:ipfs stayed out of scope as the bead required. THE DESIGN DECISION WORTH KNOWING: hire holds no key material of its own, so the secret half is looked for in an agent rather than in a file hire reads -- a keystore would have added a file format, made hire a secret custodian, and pre-empted persona-lnaj. Cost stated in the module header: a did:key no local agent can answer for enumerates and does not prove. HIRE_DID_KEYS is unchanged and still names public identifiers, so the change is purely additive.
